FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id LEFT JOIN district AS j_district ON a.district_id = j_district.district_id WHERE l.date >= '1997-01-01'

AND t.trans_id = 3356

SELECT 
    CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT c.gender) AS REAL) / COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) * 100 AS percentage
FROM client c
JOIN account a ON c.district_id = a.district_id
WHERE a.frequency IN ('POPLATEK MESICNE', 'POPLATEK TYDNE', 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU')
AND (SELECT AVG(A11) FROM district d WHERE d.A11 > 10000) > 0

SELECT 
    ROUND(
        ((SUM(CASE WHEN c.gender = 'M' THEN l.amount ELSE NULL END) - SUM(CASE WHEN c.gender = 'M' THEN l.amount ELSE NULL END)) / SUM(CASE WHEN c.gender = 'M' THEN l.amount ELSE NULL END)) * 100, 
        2
    ) AS growth_rate
FROM loan l
JOIN client c ON l.account_id = c.client_id
WHERE c.gender = 'M'
AND l.date >= '1996-01-01'
AND l.date <= '1997-12-31'

SELECT 
    COUNT(DISTINCT t.account_id) AS frequency,
    SUM(t.amount) AS total_amount
FROM trans t
WHERE t.account_id = 3

SELECT 
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN c.gender = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM client c
JOIN account a ON c.district_id = a.district_id
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN card k ON d.disp_id = k.disp_id
WHERE k.type IN ('gold', 'classic', 'junior')
  AND k.issued IS NOT NULL
  AND c.gender = 'M'
  AND c.birth_date >= DATE('now', '-1 week')
ORDER BY percentage DESC

SELECT DISTINCT a.account_id
FROM account a
JOIN client c ON a.district_id = c.district_id
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN order o ON d.account_id = o.account_to
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  AND (
    -- Calculate average salary for each female client
    AVG(o.amount) IS NOT NULL
  )
GROUP BY a.account_id, c.gender

SELECT AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE l.status = 'C' AND l.date >= (SELECT MIN(date) FROM loan WHERE status = 'C')
  AND l.date < (SELECT MAX(date) FROM loan WHERE status = 'C')
